description: Invented web-form leads for Acme Outdoor Gear. Labels: category, priority (sales categories only), duplicate (CRM or earlier in the batch) and route. Items marked heldout were written with the rest but never used while tuning prompts or rules.

rubric.priority: hot = clear quantity or budget AND a date within about six weeks, or an existing stockist reordering; warm = genuine interest with some detail but no date or budget; cold = vague, early, or a poor fit. Only scored for sales categories.
rubric.route: sales_followup for the four sales categories, support for retail_customer, discard for spam
